observations.behavior: Adds a new test, test_rank_before_arrays_preserves_results, with parameterized inputs and time-machine travel, asserting that the optimized ClickHouse query preserves results and columns while including dense_rank() and excluding arrayFold when the feature flag is enabled.
observations.posthog_connection: This is a regression and compatibility test for a backend query optimization. It checks that the new ranked-breakdown-row implementation does not change the results or column metadata compared to the baseline, while also checking that the SQL includes the expected dense_rank() function and excludes arrayFold, which is the optimization being tested.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check, if self._use_ranked_breakdown_rows, to delegate to the new ranked breakdown query implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk introduces the control flow that enables the new ranked breakdown query. It checks a property before executing the new SQL, allowing the rest of the query builder to remain unchanged. This is the entry point for the optimization.

observations.behavior: Adds a cached property, _use_ranked_breakdown_rows, which evaluates several conditions including the team flag, trends-breakdown-rank-before-arrays, and other query parameters to decide whether to use the ranked breakdown rows query.
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk defines the conditions under which the ranked breakdown rows query is used. It checks the breakdown type, series, math, display, and the team flag. This is the core configuration and feature flag check for the optimization.
